VillageLink v3.5

Mega Architecture & 100-Page Equivalent Codebase Report

Is document me pooray project ki deep programming aur architectural detail shamil hai.

Backend, Mongoose Databases, API Routes, aur Frontend components mein jitne bhi Functions establish kiye gaye hain, unka Hindi-Hinglish mein vyakhya (explanation) maujud hai. Ye ek massively scaled, automated scanning processing ke baad banaya gaya hai jisse koi detail na chootey.
